page.layout: Running head centred at top with page number right; two lines of italic text above an engraved plate of coins (full width, not text); below the plate a centred chapter heading, then an italic caption in full width, then the opening paragraph of the text with a large initial, ending with a catchword-like signature line "M 2" and "Hd" at the foot right.

p.i: rum imaginum cuiusmodi antea solebant, nullas. Intellegit aureas imagines vultusque Imperato-rum.

main_text.head: CAP. XVI.

p.i: Crux in militum armis: in Imperatorum capite & manibus: in monachorum veste: inseri eam praferunt, & templa.

main_text.p: NEc vero in Signis solùm Crux expressa, sed etiam ipsorum militum armis. Eusebius:

page.notes: The plate shows coins with a Chi-Rho monogram, a Victory figure with the legend VICT. AVG., and labelled tablets reading "Ex auro", "Ex lapide lazuli", "Ex argento", "Ex aere". The legends on the coins are partly illegible. The foot signature reads "M 2" and "Hd" and is printed at the foot right; the final catchword is not reliably legible.
